# dmidecode 3.5
Getting SMBIOS data from sysfs.
SMBIOS 3.3.0 present.

Handle 0x0000, DMI type 0, 26 bytes

	Version: 1.4b
	Release Date: 06/14/2024
	ROM Size: 64 MB
	BIOS Revision: 5.22

	Family: SMC X12
